name: Caption Writer
description: Your AI looks at your photo and writes four captions in the tone you pick, funny, poetic, bold or sweet, with hashtags for each platform.
prompt: A caption writer powered by the AI: pick a photo, a tone and a platform, add optional context, and get four different captions with hashtags to copy or share.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Tu IA mira tu foto y escribe cuatro pies de foto en el tono que elijas, divertido, poético, atrevido o tierno, con hashtags para cada red.
